summary: Your sixth Sunday review. You answer 8 questions on embeddings, the model API and retrieval, write the module 3 retrospective, write note 2 of your checkpoint (why embeddings, not only keywords), tag week 6 and plan module 4.
goal: Say what broke in module 3, write note 2 of your checkpoint, and plan module 4.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 8 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Retrospective: write 3 things that broke, the real cause, what got better, and one habit to change
Write note 2 of the checkpoint with your own examples from Day 37 to Day 42
Error log: group this week's confusions into 3 themes and fix the top one with a 5-minute experiment
Run git tag week-6 and see tag: week-6 in git log --oneline --decorate
Plan week 7: write one outcome sentence, put 7 sessions in your calendar, and write your drop list
Play the M3 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
